FormDefinition.title: FormDefinition
FormDefinition.description: A mobile-first form containing ordered interactive questions and response counters.

userId.description: Owner UID matching Firebase Auth UID.

description.description: Subtitle or instructions for responders (0-500 chars).

accentColorKey.description: Theme accent color key for the form header.

acceptingResponses.description: Whether new submissions are currently enabled.

questions.description: Ordered list of 1 to 25 question maps (id, prompt, type, required, options, scaleMin, scaleMax, minLabel, maxLabel).

responseCount.description: Denormalized count of submitted responses incremented atomically.

FormResponse.title: FormResponse
FormResponse.description: A submitted form response containing structured answers and timing/offline telemetry.

userId.description: Owner UID matching the parent user scope.

answers.description: List of 1 to 25 answer maps (questionId, questionType, textValue, numericValue, selectedOptions).

completionSeconds.description: Duration in seconds taken to complete the form (0-86400).

submittedOffline.description: True if queued while network was offline before syncing.

/users/{userId}/forms/{formId}/responses.description: Submitted responses scoped under a specific form.
